title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology, Part-time
bio: Dr. Kadambari (Kady) Rawal BDS, CAGS, MSD, FASGD, FICD joined the faculty at Harvard in 2019. She serves on the boards of organizations like the American Association of Women Dentists' Smiles for Success Foundation and the Boston District Dental Society. She has contributed to several clinical outreach efforts to bring dental care and oral health education to women and older adults locally in Boston, nationally in the United States as well as internationally in India, her home county.
